name: Willro Reviews
author: sitgram

sections.description:
Willro Reviews is a simple and lightweight review plugin for WordPress.

External Services

This plugin connects to the Willro API (https://prod.willro.com/api/v1/integration/business-api) to fetch and display your business reviews and related business information.

What the service is and what it is used for:
– Willro API is used to retrieve reviews data and business info used by the shortcode/block/templates.

What data is sent and when:
– When a page containing the Willro Reviews shortcode/block/widget is loaded, your server sends requests to the Willro API including your configured API key (in the request headers) and query parameters such as limit/page/mediaType/rating/sortType.
– When you click “Test Connection” in the plugin settings, your server sends a request to the Willro API to verify the API key.
– Review images/videos may be loaded by the visitor’s browser from media URLs returned by the Willro API.

Service provider terms and privacy policy:
– Terms: https://www.willro.com/terms-and-conditions
– Privacy Policy: https://www.willro.com/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate through the Plugins menu in WordPress
